# Documented locale list for the reduced ICU data step (spike task-94). One ICU locale id per
# line; '#' starts a comment. Rationale, per-locale cost, and the measured tiers are in
# docs/design/icu-data.md.
#
# This is the "recommended" tier: the framework reference set. A shipped app should trim this
# further to the locales it actually ships, or keep the framework set and bundle per-app locale
# packs. Every listed locale pulls in its fallback ancestors (root), and region variants that a
# listed locale subdivides through (for example en_GB -> en_001) are added automatically.
#
# root carries the locale-independent defaults; en is the fallback for everything else.
root
en
en_GB
de
fr
es
it
pt
pt_BR
nl
pl
ru
tr
ar
he
hi
th
vi
ja
ko
zh
zh_Hant
